defect_found_while_verifying.what: GET /v1/influencers/me/discover-brands returned 500 in its DEFAULT state — no filters applied.
defect_found_while_verifying.cause: discoverEligibleBrands pushed influencerId as $1 but never referenced it, so Postgres rejected the statement: "could not determine data type of parameter $1". Separately, three filter placeholders had lost their dollar sign, so ILIKE/category/city searches interpolated a bare number and would have failed too.
defect_found_while_verifying.impact: "Find brands to pitch" — the creator's entire outbound route — has never worked for anyone. Throwing the switch without this fix would have opened five brands onto a screen that errors.
defect_found_while_verifying.found_by: verifying the switch reached the creator's screen rather than assuming the database change was the change
defect_found_while_verifying.verified: all five filter combinations run against production: none 5, search 1, category 2, city 1, all-three 1

defect_2026_08_25.reported: founder: "if i click on add to group it is opening influencer search, but when i click on particular influencer then asking add to campaign and request collabration. no options for adding to group"
defect_2026_08_25.cause: BrandGroupDetailScreen navigated to BrandInfluencerBrowse — the OLD creator search — passing addToGroupId. That screen has never heard of groups, so it ignored the parameter and opened a profile on tap. The screen that understands the mode is BrandFindCreators, built in this same stage: it ticks rows instead of opening profiles and shows an "Add to group" button.
defect_2026_08_25.my_mistake: I built BrandFindCreators in Stage 1 and never re-pointed the group flow at it.
defect_2026_08_25.fix: One route name. Both screens verified to live in CreatorsStack, so the navigate resolves — a cross-stack navigate fails silently at runtime and passes every build check.
defect_2026_08_25.found_while_sweeping: The BrandFindCreators ROUTE was never navigated to by anything. The Find screen works only because it is rendered inline inside the Creators tab. So the brand app carried two creator search screens, and the one place that needed the new one used the old one. With this fix, BrandInfluencerBrowse has no entry point at all and should be retired — two search screens is how they drift apart, and this bug was that drift.
defect_2026_08_25.verified: Mobile suite 159/159. Duplicate-route check clean across all stacks. Android bundle builds. Group detail already reloads on focus, so added creators appear on return.

creators_tab_pass_2026_08_25.founder: "keep this influencer proposals in creators tab, it is not new right ..all this is actions before making detailed campaign", then "take your best decision on this UI/UX".
creators_tab_pass_2026_08_25.decision: FOUR sub-tabs, not five. Talking already holds both directions sorted by whose turn it is, so a Pitches tab would show the same conversations twice, and five labels across a phone truncate. What was missing was a way in and an honest name, not a tab.
changes: "Who can pitch you" moved to the top of Talking, stating the position in words and opening the existing settings sheet. It was under Profile > Influencer Proposals behind a control labelled "Filters" — which reads as show-me-fewer, not decide-who-may-reach-me.
Bulk send relabelled from "Select" (a mode name) to "Ask several", so the screen says what it can do before anything is picked.
Old creator search BrandInfluencerBrowse retired; the Home tile now opens the Creators tab.
mistakes_caught: I claimed the old screen had no entry point left. It did — my grep searched for navigate('BrandInfluencerBrowse' and missed the Home screen, which reaches it via a target: property. Removing it from the navigator first would have left a Home tile pointing at nothing.

Three style tokens did not exist: fonts is not imported in that screen, and neither ig.sunk nor ig.white are real (ig.bg is). The fonts reference would have thrown at module load — builds cleanly, dies on the handset. Now verified mechanically: all 12 ig.* tokens resolve, all 11 Home tiles point at registered routes.

creators_tab_pass_2026_08_25.correction: Reported as MOVED; it had only been ADDED. The Profile > Influencer Proposals row was still there, so pitches lived in two places at once — the same two-doors-to-one-thing fault this stage kept hitting, immediately after writing the lesson about it. Now genuinely moved: the Profile row is gone, pitches are reached from Talking, and the orphaned ProposalInbox registration in ProfileStack was removed.
